battle.name: 陳瑱
battle.brief: 隋煬帝大業九年（613）八月，浙西信安郡，賊帥陳瑱聚眾三萬攻陷郡城；同年蒼梧梁慧尚、東陽李三兒亦舉兵，見《隋書·煬帝紀》。攻城靠刀叉與夜襲，官軍以郡兵與弩手鎮壓。卡面羅馬弩砲屬公元前一的扭力器械，相隔一千六百餘年，不見於浙西城頭；中國的對應物是機弩與床弩，皆以單發重箭制人叢。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這是一場隋朝與流民起義軍之間的地方性戰鬥，交戰地點在隋朝江南東道會稽郡所屬的信安一帶，即今浙江衢州一帶。朝廷一方是隋朝：皇帝是隋煬帝楊廣，大業九年（613）時自居洛陽，遠在涿郡與遼東的前線統兵於東北，國內的軍政由尚書省與兵部等分掌；地方上則靠郡縣官員就地組織抵抗，信安郡的太守、縣令率郡兵與縣兵守城，郡兵之外更有由各地募來的「驍果」充當近衛與鎮壓主力。起義一方沒有國號，也沒有正式編制，陳瑱是《隋書》明載的「賊帥」，與梁慧尚、李三兒同在大業九年帝紀的條目之內；這支部伍眾三萬，攻陷郡城後大掠而去，此後便再無記載。整體格局是：隋廷把主力集中於高句麗戰線，腹地與江南只留少量郡縣兵與募兵，地方一旦出現數萬人的集結，郡兵往往不足以應付，朝廷只能靠分派各郡郡兵、臨時徵發與鄰郡支援逐次平定。就編制而言，這是中央對地方、郡兵對流民的典型對抗，也是隋末亂局最早成形的一批案例之一。
countriesEn: This was a local clash between the Sui dynasty and a rebel force of displaced villagers, fought in the Xin'an area of the Jiangnan East Circuit, in what is now the Quzhou region of Zhejiang. On the court side stood the Sui: the emperor was Yang Guang, Emperor Yang of Sui, who in the ninth year of Daye (613) kept his capital at Luoyang while the bulk of his troops were committed to the northeastern front around Zhuo Commandery and Liaodong, and military administration at the centre was divided among the Department of State Affairs and the Ministry of War. Locally, defence was left to the commandery and county officers: the governor of Xin'an Commandery and the local magistrate led commandery troops and county militia to hold the walls, supplemented by the xiaoguo, the ad-hoc imperial guards and enforcers recruited by the court from all over the empire. The rebel side had no state name and no formal organisation. Chen Zhen is the one the History of Sui explicitly records as a bandit chieftain (zeishuai), listed together with Liang Huishang and Li San'er in the same annal entry for the ninth year of Daye. His force numbered thirty thousand men; after taking the commandery seat they plundered and left, and no further record of them survives. The overall pattern is this: the Sui court had concentrated its main force on the Goguryeo front, leaving only thin commandery militias and recruited troops in the interior and the south, so whenever tens of thousands gathered in one place the local militia was plainly insufficient and the court could only proceed by dispatching the militias of several commanderies, raising men ad hoc, and supporting neighbouring units in turn. In terms of organisation, then, this was the classic collision of a centre against the localities, of regular militia against displaced villagers, and one of the earliest formed cases of the disorder that would end the Sui.
people: 留下姓名的，朝廷一方是隋煬帝楊廣這位最高統帥，以及一位以文官兼領兵事的起義者楊玄感。楊玄感是弘農出身的關隴舊族，隋文帝時已任禮部尚書，大業九年六月在黎陽起兵，丙辰兵逼東都洛陽，河南贊務裴弘策出城拒戰反被擊敗；八月壬寅，宇文述等將他打敗於閿鄉，斬之，餘黨悉平——這是同年最有名的一場叛亂，也說明隋廷手中仍握有能快速平叛的精兵。同月癸卯，吳人朱爕與晉陵人管崇擁眾十萬餘寇江左；九月己卯，濟陰人吳海流、東海人彭孝才並舉兵為盜，眾數萬；九月庚辰，賊帥梁慧尚率眾四萬陷蒼梧郡；九月丁酉，東陽人李三兒與向但子舉兵作亂，眾至萬餘。十月丁酉，賊帥呂明星率眾數千圍東郡，被武賁郎將費青奴擊斬，這是同年留下明確戰果的一場平叛。陳瑱本人只在帝紀裡留下「賊帥」二字，生平、籍貫與下場都無從考證；同名的李三兒是東陽郡金華縣人，梁慧尚是蒼梧郡封川縣人，兩人的鄉貫都說明這一年的亂事多由地方鄉里動員而成。朝廷一端能點名的人物同樣多半只是帝紀中一行短記：司農卿、光祿大夫、葛國公趙元淑以罪伏誅，九月甲午皇帝因「供費不給」在 上谷大怒，免了太守虞荷等官；兵部侍郎斛斯政在六月兵敗奔於高句麗。於是這場戰爭裡真正被記錄下來的，是制度層面的崩壞，而不是任何一方將領的戰術。
peopleEn: Those whose names survive are, on the court side, the supreme commander Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang, and one rebel who led an army in the dress of a civil servant, Yang Xiangan. Yang Xiangan came from the old Hongnong clan of the Guanzhong aristocracy, was already Minister of Rites under Emperor Wen, and in the sixth month of the ninth year of Daye raised troops at Liyang; on the bingchen day he pressed up to the eastern capital of Luoyang, where Pei Hongce, the district supervisor of Henan, was beaten in the field. On the renyin day of the eighth month Yuwen Shu and his colleagues defeated him at Lanxiang and took his head, and the rest of his band was scattered. This was the most famous rebellion of the year, and it also showed that the Sui court still held troops capable of crushing an insurrection quickly. In the same month, on the guimao day, Zhu Xie of Wu and Guan Chong of Jinling gathered more than a hundred thousand men and raided the Jiangnan shore; on the jiyou day of the ninth month Wu Hailiu of Jiyin and Peng Xiaocai of Donghai rose as bandits with several tens of thousands; on the gengchen day of that month the bandit chieftain Liang Huishang led forty thousand men and took Wanggong Commandery; on the dingyou day the people of Dongyang, Li San'er and Xiang Danzi, rose in revolt with more than ten thousand. On the dingyou day of the tenth month the bandit chieftain Lü Mingxing led several thousand men to surround Dong Commandery and was killed by Fei Qingnu, a captain of the Wu Guard; this was the only suppression of that year for which an explicit result was recorded. Chen Zhen himself survives only as the two characters 'bandit chieftain' in the annal; his origins, his home county and his fate cannot be traced. The two names that can be placed geographically, Li San'er of Jinhua in Dongyang Commandery and Liang Huishang of Fengchuan in Cangwu Commandery, show that the disturbances of this year were raised largely by local village communities. The identifiable men on the court side are likewise mostly one-line entries in the annal: Zhao Yuanshu, Minister of Agriculture, Grand Master of Ceremonial, Duke of Ge, was executed for his crimes; on the jiawu day of the ninth month the emperor reached Shanggu, flew into a rage because supplies and funds had failed to keep up, and dismissed governor Yu He and others; the Vice Minister of War, Husi Zheng, fled to Goguryeo in the sixth month. What this war really preserves, then, is the decay of institutions rather than the tactics of any commander.
kits: 卡面是羅馬弩砲，公元前一世紀的扭力弩砲：木製弩身配兩組銅製扭力箍，弦儲在箍中，扳機解扣時箍體扭轉帶動弩弦，一發只出一具箭；整具重約五十至七十公斤，通常架在三腳架或車載平台上，標稱有效射程四百至五百公尺，羅馬人用它拆希臘城牆，也用它壓制方陣中的人叢。六一三年的浙西城頭不會有這種器械，當時中國與它功能相當的是弩：臂弩以手臂張弦，蹶張弩用腰足之力張弦，機弩與弩車則以木製機體配合絞盤或腳踏槓弦，一次可發十數箭乃至數十箭，漢末以來流行的連弩更在弩機上加裝自動裝填的撥桿。攻城與守城的器械譜系另成一套：撞車、雲梯、巢車、拋石用的砲，加上壕壘與鹿角。陳瑱這支起義軍的裝備更簡陋，無非是流民自帶的鐮、鋤、叉、杵與弓箭標槍，攻郡城靠夜裏攀垣、火攻與人數壓迫，破了城便大掠而去，繳獲的布帛、糧食與兵器再拿去裝備自己；隋軍這邊則是州縣郡兵、募來的驍果與北征高句麗的宿衛軍，裝備齊整，有弓弩、有甲胄、有馬匹，攻城用撞車與雲梯，守城以弩矢壓制城頭，並靠驛傳與郡縣倉儲供應糧秣。卡面那一具「一發一矢」的羅馬弩砲，與本役真正對得上的，是它在功能上的位置：以單發精確射擊打穿密集人叢，在沒有騎兵衝鋒的城池攻防中取代替代品——在六一三年中國的答案是弩陣與砲，而不是扭力箍。
kitsEn: The card shows the Roman scorpio, a torsion-powered artillery piece of the first century BC: a wooden frame carrying two sets of bronze torsion skeins, the bowstring stored inside them, so that when the trigger is released the skeins snap forward and drive the string, loosing exactly one heavy bolt per shot. The whole machine weighed roughly fifty to seventy kilograms and was normally set on a tripod or a cart platform, with a rated effective range of four to five hundred metres; the Romans used it to break Greek city walls and to break up the massed infantry of Greek phalanxes. No such machine stood on a wall in western Zhejiang in 613. The Chinese weapon of comparable function was the crossbow: the shoulder bow was drawn with the arm, the spanzhang crossbow with the waist and legs, while the mounted crossbow and the crossbow cart used a wooden mechanism with a windlass or a treadle lever and could loose a dozen or several dozen bolts in a burst, and the repeating crossbows popular since the late Han added a loading lever to the trigger assembly. Siege and defence kit formed a separate lineage: battering rams, scaling ladders, siege towers, stone-throwing trebuchets, plus ditches and chevaux-de-frise. The equipment of Chen Zhen's band was far poorer, nothing beyond sickles, hoes, pitchforks, cudgels, bows and javelins carried by the refugees themselves; they stormed the commandery seat by climbing the walls at night, by fire and by sheer weight of numbers, and once it fell they plundered and left, taking cloth, grain and weapons to re-equip themselves. The Sui side, made up of commandery and county militia, recruited xiaoguo and the imperial guards already committed to Goguryeo, was properly equipped with bows and crossbows, armour and horses; it assaulted with rams and ladders, defended the walls with crossbow bolts, and sustained itself through the relay post system and the granaries of the commanderies. The real point of contact between the card's one-bolt scorpio and this war is functional: a single precisely aimed shot that punches through a massed body of men, used as a substitute for cavalry charge in an assault on fortifications. In China in 613 that substitute was the crossbow line and the trebuchet, not the torsion skein.
tactics: 起義軍的戰法是典型的流民攻城：先是鄉里召集群眾、聚眾三萬，然後在官軍反應之前直撲郡治信安，夜裏四面同攻，靠人數與亂軍之勢破門；城破之後不是留城固守，而是大掠而去，把糧食、衣物、兵仗一併帶走，或散入山林、寺觀重新結集。朝廷的應對分層展開：七月己卯詔令所在發人修築城縣與府驛站，丁未又詔郡縣城去道五里以上者一律徙城就道，把城塞與運道綁在一起；戊申詔盜賊籍沒其家，以連坐斷絕流民的社會網路；甲辰則制驍果之家蠲免賦役，用免賦換取募兵的家屬不致逃亡。平叛的實際戰術由各郡自行執行：郡兵與縣兵先守城，弩手在城頭壓制攀垣者，繼而由都督、郡丞率騎兵與步卒出城搜索，把起義隊伍從據點中趕出來，再截斷其糧道；糧道一斷，人數雖眾而無食，隊伍便自行瓦解——十月丁酉費青奴在東郡一戰斬呂明星，正是這種以小股精兵吃掉首領、令餘眾潰散的打法。與之相比，卡面羅馬弩砲的用法在原理上屬於守方：把弩固定在台座上，瞄準密集行進的方陣，單發重箭在數百公尺外擊穿前列盾牌；但信安一役的守方是起義者而非官軍，他們沒有弩砲那樣的器械，攻城靠的是更原始的密集人潮，而平叛的官軍在騎兵、弩手與糧秣調配上佔優，這一點決定了這場戰爭的結局。
tacticsEn: The rebel method was that of displaced villagers storming a city: neighbours were first drawn together until thirty thousand men had gathered, and then, before the authorities could react, the column struck straight at the commandery seat of Xin'an, attacking from all sides in the night and breaking the gates on weight of numbers and confusion. Having taken the city they did not hold it; they plundered and left, carrying off grain, cloth and weapons, or dispersed into the hills and into temples to re-form. The court's response was layered. On the jiyou day of the seventh month an edict ordered every locality to raise men to build the walls of cities and counties and the relay stations; on the dingwei day another edict ordered commandery and county seats standing more than five li off the road to be moved closer to it, binding fortifications to the lines of transport. On the wushen day it was ordered that the families of bandits be registered and confiscated, cutting the refugees off from their social networks by collective liability; and on the jiachen day the households of the xiaoguo were exempted from taxes and corvée, buying the loyalty of the families of recruited guards so that they would not run away. The actual work of suppression was left to the individual commanderies: commandery and county militia first held the walls, crossbowmen on the ramparts shot down those climbing, and then commandery governors and deputy governors took cavalry and infantry out of the cities to hunt the insurgents from their strongholds and cut their supply lines. Once the supply line was cut, a crowd of any size, having no food, dissolved on its own. The defeat of Lü Mingxing at Dong Commandery on the dingyou day of the tenth month, killed by Fei Qingnu, is precisely this pattern: a small body of reliable troops destroys the leader and the rest of the crowd scatters. By contrast, the use of the card's Roman scorpio belongs in principle to the defence: the engine is fixed on its platform, aimed at a phalanx advancing in close order, and a single heavy bolt strikes through the front rank of shields several hundred metres out. But in the fighting at Xin'an the defenders were the insurgents, not the court, and they had nothing like a bolt-thrower; their assault relied on a cruder human tide. The suppressing force, with cavalry, crossbowmen and the handling of supply, held the advantage, and that, rather than any technical difference in weapons, decided how the war ended.
data: 可核對的數字都集中在《隋書·煬帝紀》與《北史·隋本紀下》同一條紀年上。大業九年（613）四月庚午，隋煬帝車駕渡遼，遣宇文述、楊義臣趣平壤；五月己卯，濟北人甄寶車聚眾萬餘，寇掠城邑；六月乙巳，禮部尚書楊玄感反於黎陽，丙辰逼東都；七月癸未，餘杭人劉元進舉兵反，眾至數萬；八月癸卯，吳人朱爕、晉陵人管崇擁眾十萬餘，自稱將軍，寇江左；同日戊申詔盜賊籍沒其家，乙卯賊帥陳瑱等眾三萬攻陷信安郡；九月己卯濟陰人吳海流、東海人彭孝才並舉兵為盜，眾數萬，庚辰梁慧尚率眾四萬陷蒼梧郡，丁酉李三兒與向但子舉兵作亂，眾至萬餘；十月丁酉呂明星率眾數千圍東郡，被武賁郎將費青奴擊斬。就本役規模而言，陳瑱部三萬人是同年江南諸役中較大的一支，比李三兒的萬餘人多，比梁慧尚的四萬人少，與朱爕、管崇的十萬餘眾相比則集中在浙西一郡之內，可見起義的地理單位是郡而不是州。戰場空間方面，信安郡治一帶在今浙江衢州，境內多山嶺與丘陵，道路狹隘，郡兵一旦出城搜索便容易失去聯繫；陳瑱能在官府反應之前完成三萬人的集結與攻城，說明當時郡縣的徵發與通信系統已然空轉。卡面器械的數字可與本役對照：羅馬弩砲重約五十至七十公斤，標稱射程四百至五百公尺，一發一具箭，兩次發射之間以分鐘計；同時代中國的機弩一次可連發十數箭，覆蓋面與射速都在它之上，只是單發的精度與穿透力不及重箭。
dataEn: Every number that can be checked sits in a single annal sequence in the Emperor Yang chapter of the History of Sui and the Sui annals of the History of the Northern Dynasties. In the fourth month of the ninth year of Daye (613), on the gengwu day, the emperor's carriage crossed the Liao river and Yuwen Shu and Yang Yichen were sent towards Pyongyang; in the fifth month, on the jiyou day, Zhen Baochuo of Jibei gathered more than ten thousand men and raided the towns; in the sixth month, on the yisi day, Yang Xiangan, Minister of Rites, rebelled at Liyang and on the bingchen day pressed against the eastern capital; in the seventh month, on the guiwei day, Liu Yuanjin of Yuhang rose in revolt with a crowd running to several tens of thousands; in the eighth month, on the guimao day, Zhu Xie of Wu and Guan Chong of Jinling gathered more than a hundred thousand men, styled themselves generals, and raided the Jiangnan shore; on the wushen day of the same month the families of bandits were ordered registered and confiscated, and on the yimao day the bandit chieftain Chen Zhen with thirty thousand men took Xin'an Commandery. In the ninth month, on the jiyou day, Wu Hailiu of Jiyin and Peng Xiaocai of Donghai rose as bandits with several tens of thousands; on the gengchen day Liang Huishang led forty thousand men into Wanggong Commandery; on the dingyou day Li San'er and Xiang Danzi rose in revolt with more than ten thousand. In the tenth month, on the dingyou day, Lü Mingxing with several thousand men surrounded Dong Commandery and was cut down by Fei Qingnu, captain of the Wu Guard. In terms of scale, Chen Zhen's thirty thousand was among the larger of the southern rising forces of that year: more than Li San'er's ten thousand, fewer than Liang Huishang's forty thousand, and far below the hundred-odd thousand of Zhu Xie and Guan Chong, but concentrated inside a single commandery of western Zhejiang, which shows that the geographical unit of these risings was the commandery rather than the prefecture. As for the ground itself, the seat of Xin'an Commandery lies in what is now Quzhou, Zhejiang, a country of hills and narrow roads, where militia leaving the city to search easily lost contact with each other. That Chen Zhen could complete the muster of thirty thousand men and the assault before the authorities reacted shows that the system of levy and communication in the commanderies had already seized up. The numbers of the card's machine set the comparison: the Roman scorpio weighed about fifty to seventy kilograms, was rated at four to five hundred metres, fired a single bolt, and needed minutes between shots; the Chinese mounted crossbow of the same age could loose a dozen bolts in a burst, and covered more ground and fired faster, though a single bolt of its lighter construction carried neither the accuracy nor the penetration of the Roman heavy bolt.
cause: 陳瑱能在六一三年八月打下信安郡，根源在隋朝把國力一次押在東北而江南空虛。開皇以來，隋朝倚重府兵與均田，天下尚能供給；到了大業年間，三征高句麗、大破吐谷渾、兩巡江都、重建東都與洛陽的工程接連展開，徭役與兵費同時加到每一戶頭上，籍戶銳減、逃戶成千上萬地流竄江淮與江南。五月河南大旱，五月又有疫癘，糧食歉收的同時，隋煬帝照樣在四月渡遼、遣宇文述與楊義臣趣平壤，把最後一批可以調動的兵與糧押上東北戰線；六月庚午班師之後，帝國的財政與信用同時垮塌。徵兵與徵糧的機制失靈還只是表徵，深層的問題是統治的合法性：六月到八月之間，江南山東、淮南、河北、嶺南的郡縣相繼失守，說明百姓不再相信朝廷能維持秩序，於是地方豪強、僧道與逃戶一起把武裝結社化，用最現成的手段——搶糧、攻城、占據驛道——取代官府。陳瑱這樣一個此前並無聞名的人能聚起三萬眾，正說明大業九年的問題不是某一位領袖的野心，而是一整個郡縣社會在國家崩解邊緣的自保式武裝：百姓寧可自己立寨自保，也不願再等一紙徵發文書。
causeEn: Chen Zhen was able to take Xin'an Commandery in August 613 because the Sui had staked the entire state on the northeast while the south was left hollow. Under the Kaihuang reign the dynasty rested on the fubing militia and the equal-field system, and the empire could still bear its charges; under Daye the third war against Goguryeo, the campaigns against the Tuyuhun, the two inspection tours of Jiangdu and the rebuilding of the eastern and northern capitals came one after another, and military service and taxation were laid on every household at the same time. The registered households thinned out and tens of thousands of fugitives drifted through the Yangtze and Huai valleys and into the south. There was drought in Henan, there was sickness, the harvest failed, and all the same the emperor crossed the Liao in the fourth month and sent Yuwen Shu and Yang Yichen towards Pyongyang, committing the last troops and the last grain he could move to the northeastern front. After the army withdrew in the sixth month the fiscal capacity and the credit of the empire had collapsed together. The failure of the levy and of the grain collections was only the surface of the problem; the deeper issue was the legitimacy of rule. Between the sixth and the eighth months the commanderies of the south, of Shandong, of the Huai, of the north and of Lingnan fell away one after another, showing that the people no longer believed the court could keep order. Local landowners, monks and fugitives therefore organised themselves into armed bands, replacing the government with the most readily available means: seizing grain, storming cities, holding the relay roads. The fact that a man such as Chen Zhen, of no previous renown, could muster thirty thousand says that the problem of the ninth year of Daye was not the ambition of one leader but the self-defensive arming of an entire commandery society on the edge of state collapse. The people would rather raise their own strongholds and protect themselves than wait for another written order of levy.
impact: 陳瑱攻陷信安郡，是大業九年江南亂局中最被低估的一環。隋書把這件事記在兩行字之間，前面是「制盜賊籍沒其家」的詔令，後面是司農卿趙元淑伏誅，彷彿它只是同類事件之一；但從後續看，浙西一帶的武裝化並沒有隨郡城易主而結束：大業十年之後，江南的郡縣仍有小股勢力在山間活動，隋廷每年都要發兵圍剿，兵額卻年年不敷，直到隋亡。對隋朝本身，這場戰爭的意義在於它把「討平盜賊」從地方差事變成中央財政的固定開支：從大業九年秋天起，詔令所在發人修城、徙城就道、籍沒盜賊家屬、蠲免驍果之家賦役，一連串措施都圍繞著「糧與人」打轉，而同時東北戰線上還有第三次征高句麗在等著。戰役直接導致的後果是隋朝最後一批能打的郡兵與募兵被大量消耗在地方平亂上，等到隋煬帝在江都被宇文化及逼宮時，中央已無可靠武力可用。對後世而言，大業九年的這串起義是一次大規模的驗證：它把「以郡兵平民亂」的極限擺在每一個州郡面前，也把國家崩潰時地方如何自我武裝、如何在沒有財政的情況下維持一支軍隊，記錄得清清楚楚。唐朝代隋之後，括戶整編、租庸調與府兵制的重整，多少都帶著避免重演大業九年的意味。
impactEn: Chen Zhen's taking of Xin'an Commandery is the most underrated link in the Jiangnan disorder of the ninth year of Daye. The History of Sui records it between two other things: before it stands the edict registering and confiscating the families of bandits, after it the execution of Zhao Yuanshu, Minister of Agriculture; it is treated as one more event of its kind. Yet the militarisation of western Zhejiang did not end when the city changed hands. After the tenth year of Daye, small bands were still active in the mountains of the southern commanderies, the court had to dispatch troops against them every year, and the numbers available never met the need, right up to the fall of the Sui. For the Sui itself, the meaning of this war was that suppressing bandits ceased to be a local chore and became a fixed charge on the central treasury. From the autumn of the ninth year of Daye, the edicts ordering men raised to build walls, ordering seats moved closer to the roads, ordering the families of bandits confiscated and the households of the xiaoguo relieved of taxes were all turning on grain and men, while a third campaign against Goguryeo was still waiting on the northeastern front. The direct consequence was that the last reliable commandery militia and recruited troops of the dynasty were consumed in enormous numbers on local suppression; by the time Yang Guang was cornered at Jiangdu by Yuwen Huaji, the centre had no dependable armed force left. For later ages, the risings of the ninth year of Daye amounted to a large-scale test: they put the limits of militia-based suppression before every prefecture in the empire, and they recorded, in detail, how localities armed themselves and how a force could be kept going without revenue once the state had come apart. When the Tang replaced the Sui, the re-registration of households, the rent-and-labour system and the restoration of the fubing militia all carried, to some degree, the intention of not repeating the ninth year of Daye.
result: 就六一三年八月那一天而言，結果是清楚的：陳瑱聚眾三萬，攻陷信安郡，郡治與府庫落入起義者手中，隋朝在浙西的統治一度中斷。這一役沒有留下慘烈的攻城戰報，起義軍也沒有提出守土的政治主張，破了城便大掠而去，隨即散回鄉里與山間；隋廷的記錄只用了「攻陷」兩字，再無下文。陳瑱本人此後的下落，傳世史籍沒有交代，可以確定的是他的名字在隋朝瓦解之前已不再出現於帝紀，說明這支部伍最終不是被改編、而是被拆散或被鎮壓，與同月被費青奴斬殺的呂明星、與八月被平定的楊玄感餘黨，屬同一種結局：起義可以成功佔城，卻無法在沒有財政、沒有城防、沒有號令體系的情況下守住一座城。對陳瑱個人與他的三萬眾而言，佔領信安郡是一次成功的突擊，而不是一場戰爭的結束；對隋朝而言，這場戰爭的真實代價則要在五年之後才結算完畢——當關中與關隴的精兵被抽調去平叛、當東北戰線把府庫掏空，當各地的大武裝在隋亡之後爭奪同一片中原與江南時，大業九年的每一次攻陷郡城，都變成了隋末群雄手中的第一批兵源與地盤。
resultEn: As for the single day of August 613, the outcome is plain: Chen Zhen mustered thirty thousand men, took Xin'an Commandery, and the commandery seat with its stores fell into the hands of the insurgents, so that Sui rule in western Zhejiang was interrupted for a time. No account of a bloody siege survives, and the rebels advanced no political claim to the ground they had won; they plundered and dispersed back into the villages and the hills. The court's record uses the two words 'took and occupied' and stops there. What became of Chen Zhen himself is not stated in any surviving history, and what can be established is that his name no longer appears in the annals before the Sui came apart, which means that this band was eventually neither taken into service nor left intact but broken up or put down. It was the same fate as Lü Mingxing, killed by Fei Qingnu in the same month, and as the followers of Yang Xiangan, whose revolt was crushed in the eighth month. A rising can seize a city; it cannot hold one without revenue, without fortifications and without a system of command. For Chen Zhen and his thirty thousand men, the taking of Xin'an was a successful raid rather than the end of a war. For the Sui, the real cost of this war was not settled until five years later, when the trained troops of Guanzhong had been drawn off to put down revolts, when the northeastern front had emptied the treasuries, and when the large armed groups of the post-Sui world fought over the same plains and the same river valleys of the north and the south. Every commandery seat taken in the ninth year of Daye became, in the end, the first muster of men and the first stretch of ground won by the contending warlords of the late Sui.
